questions.text: A Vue frontend, a mobile app, and another backend service all call the same Flask API deployed on multiple servers. The team chooses JWT authentication. Which of the following statements are correct?
options: Each request can carry the token, so any server can validate it without storing a per-user session in memory.

In Flask-JWT-Extended, [IMAGE: /data/images/cs2006_2026T2_Q2_NA_p6_Im12.webp|inline] can read the identity stored in the token.
Session-based authentication is usually easier to scale across multiple servers because no shared storage is needed. The team should have chosen this.
correct_answer: Each request can carry the token, so any server can validate it without storing a per-user session in memory.
JWT is API-friendly because clients can send it using the [IMAGE: /data/images/cs2006_2026T2_Q2_NA_p6_Im11.webp|inline] header.
